name: POST /api/dialer/caller-ids - Add a caller ID to the tenant's pool
description: Adds (or re-activates) a number the tenant may present as caller ID (e6ae5703-37a6-4d27-a7d5-23ec80c4a001#AC3 — outbound calls use a caller ID from the tenant's pool and store the attestation level). Body: phone_number (E.164), attestation (STIR/SHAKEN level the tenant's carrier signs it at: A full, B partial, C gateway; default B), label. Dispatch picks each outbound call's caller ID from the tenant's ACTIVE pool — a number in the destination's NANP area code first (local presence), then the least recently used — narrowed to the campaign's caller_id_pool when set, and stores it as the call's from_number with caller_id_attestation. A from number the caller names must be an active pool number (else refused caller_id_not_owned); with no usable number the call is refused no_caller_id and its slot released.

testCases.name: Add a local number with full attestation

errorCases.message: phone_number must be E.164, e.g. +14155550100 | attestation must be A, B or C | label must be at most 120 characters
